title: intro
body:
You: This is the intro passage. A new game opens it once.
You: The guide by the door wants to talk.

title: guide
body:
<<if $doorOpen>>
Guide: The door is open. The doorOpen story flag unlocks its exit.
<<else>>
Guide: I am NPC 1. My door stays locked until the doorOpen flag is true.
Guide: Bring me the parcel from the other map. Its exit is to the east.
<<if $inventory.parcel>>

[[Give the parcel|guideParcel]]
[[Not yet|goodbye]]
<<end>>
<<end>>

title: guideParcel
body:
<<removeItem, parcel>>
<<addItem, key>>
<<set $doorOpen = true>>
Guide: Thanks. removeItem took the parcel and addItem gave you a key.
Guide: The passage also set doorOpen to true, so the door opens now.

title: npc2
body:
NPC 2: I am NPC 2. What I say depends on the inventory and the door flag.
<<if $doorOpen == false>>
NPC 2: The parcel lies south-east of here, at the end of the path.
<<end>>
<<if $inventory.parcel>>

[[Ask about the parcel|npc2Parcel]]
[[Goodbye|goodbye]]
<<end>>

title: npc2Parcel
body:
NPC 2: This option shows only while the parcel is in your inventory.
NPC 2: Take it to the guide on the first map.

title: goodbye
body: You: Goodbye. Both NPCs link to this one passage.

title: signOutdoor1
body: Sign: A prop with the type sign and a node property opens that passage.

title: signIndoor1
body:
Sign: This room is smaller than the screen, so the camera stays still.
Sign: Indoor maps play the indoors track.

title: npcBackground
body: (either: "NPC: An NPC without a node property opens this passage.", "NPC: Each visit picks one line from the either list at random.")
